title: Process Reward Models Meet Planning: Generating Precise and Scalable Datasets for Step-Level Rewards
paper_type_zh: 过程/轨迹监督数据与过程奖励研究
best_for_zh: 构建、审计或复用步骤级推理反馈数据的研究者。
one_line: Process Reward Models Meet Planning: Generating Precise and Scalable Datasets for Step-Level Rewards exposes process or trace supervision data.
提出 PDDL2PRM：把可执行规划中的动作转为带精确分级奖励的推理步骤，自动生成约百万规模 PRM 训练数据。
why: It makes intermediate reasoning feedback auditable before reuse.
inclusion_reason: Process/trace supervision data release or data-construction method.

title: Problem
问题
html: Planning domains have formal transition rules, but PRMs lack training data that expose whether each proposed action remains feasible. PDDL2PRM asks how to derive process-reward supervision from planning specifications for reasoning about multi-step plans.
规划任务有形式化的状态转换规则，但过程奖励模型缺少能判断每个候选动作是否仍可行的训练数据。PDDL2PRM 研究如何从规划规范中导出过程奖励监督，用于多步计划推理。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: PDDL2PRM converts executable planning problems into about one million verifiable process-reward training examples. A planner supplies hard constraints on state transitions and action feasibility, so each partial plan can be judged automatically to yield low-ambiguity positive and negative steps and future-reachability information. It converts sparse final-outcome feedback into supervision localised to the reasoning process, supporting training and exposing divergence points.
核心贡献是：提出 PDDL2PRM，把可执行规划问题转换为约百万条可验证的过程奖励训练样本。 数据对象可概括为：规划器提供状态转移与动作可行性的硬约束；每个部分计划均可被自动判定，从而得到低歧义的正负步骤和未来可达性信息。 它把“最终答案是否正确”的稀疏反馈改写为可定位到推理过程的监督契约，因而既能服务训练，也能暴露模型在何一步开始偏离。

title: Method
方法
html: It supports scalable generation of verifiable process data and studies the boundary between symbolic planning and language reasoning. Inputs are problems, traces, and intermediate states; outputs are step labels, preferences, or continuous rewards. Reproduction should verify the generator, terminal verifier, sampling budget, and filtering rules.
方法上，适合研究可验证过程数据的规模化生成，以及从符号规划迁移到语言推理的边界。 训练或使用阶段，适合研究可验证过程数据的规模化生成，以及从符号规划迁移到语言推理的边界。 输入通常包括题目、已有轨迹与中间状态；输出是步骤标签、比较偏好或连续奖励。应分别核验生成器、终局验证器、采样预算与过滤规则，因为它们共同决定标签含义。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The verifiable evidence for “Process Reward Models Meet Planning: Generating Precise and Scalable Datasets for Step-Level Rewards” begins with its 2026 publication record in ACL 2026. The release is catalogued as a documented feedback resource, and the official record identifies a data release, a project page. These materials establish the provenance and accessibility of the resource described by the paper. They do not by themselves measure a universal improvement: the strength of a reported result depends on the paper’s task distribution, supervision design, model setting, and evaluation protocol. Any comparison of later systems therefore needs to preserve the released data version and the conditions under which the paper’s evidence was collected. The publication and its official artifacts provide the traceable basis for that interpretation and comparison.

《Process Reward Models Meet Planning: Generating Precise and Scalable Datasets for Step-Level Rewards》的可追溯证据首先来自其 2026 年在 ACL 2026 发表或发布的记录。该发布被归入有文档说明的反馈资源，官方记录标明其提供数据发布、项目主页。这些材料能够说明论文所述资源的来源和可访问状态，却不能单独度量普遍性能提升。任何结果的力度仍取决于论文采用的任务分布、监督设计、模型设置和评测协议。比较后续系统时，需要保留发布版本以及论文收集证据时的条件。论文和其官方工件共同构成解释这些结果时可回溯的依据，也明确限定了结论能够追溯的材料范围。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Compared with one label for a whole chain of thought, this work changes the unit or acquisition path of process evidence. PDDL2PRM converts executable planning problems into about one million verifiable process-reward training examples. A planner supplies hard constraints on state transitions and action feasibility, so each partial plan can be judged automatically to yield low-ambiguity positive and negative steps and future-reachability information. Its reusable contribution is the data contract, quality control, and evaluation boundary.
相对把整条 CoT 只标为对或错的做法，该工作改变的是过程数据的采集或使用单位。提出 PDDL2PRM，把可执行规划问题转换为约百万条可验证的过程奖励训练样本。 这也是它进入 Process / Trace Supervision Data 的原因；但“使用过程奖励”本身并非新意，真正应复用的是其数据契约、质量控制与评测边界。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The formal PDDL world is far from open natural-language tasks, and automatic truth does not guarantee that a verbalised explanation is also correct. Process scores support training or search but do not replace executable checks, human review, or domain expertise; transfer requires sample audits.
局限需要与贡献一并阅读：PDDL 的形式化世界与自然语言开放任务差距很大；自动真值不保证语言化解释同样正确。 过程分数是训练或搜索的辅助信号，不能替代可执行验证、人工审核或领域专家判断。跨领域使用前，至少应抽样检查标签是否仍对应目标任务中的真实错误。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For data researchers, the paper is a concrete recipe to compare: state granularity, candidate source, label or preference construction, negative examples, and acceptance criteria. For model builders it can support PRM training, best-of-N reranking, tree search, and trace filtering. For evaluators, first-error localization and calibration matter more than answer accuracy alone.
对数据研究者，最直接的价值是把该工作当成一份可比较的数据配方：明确状态粒度、候选来源、标签或偏好产生机制、负例构造和验收指标。对模型研究者，它可用于 PRM 训练、best-of-N 重排、树搜索和轨迹过滤；对评测者，则应优先报告首错定位与校准而非只报最终正确率。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: A productive reading order is to inspect availability and provenance first, then trace context and label evidence, and only then study the reported gain. Compare the design with PRM800K, rollout-derived labels, and preference-tree supervision. Finally, inspect high-scoring wrong traces to determine whether the verifier learned reasoning quality or superficial style, length, and answer leakage.
阅读时建议先检查数据对象是否可获得、样本是否保留原始上下文、标签是否可追溯到验证证据，再看模型提升。其次比较它与 PRM800K、自动 rollout 标签和偏好树方法的差异。最后手工抽取若干高分错误轨迹，判断奖励模型到底识别了推理质量，还是偏好了格式、长度或答案泄漏。
